fields.about_text: I'm Maria Shoaib, a clinical dietitian and nutritionist trained at UVAS Lahore. I work one-on-one with clients across Pakistan to build nutrition plans that fit their real lives — our food, our routines, our cultural context. My approach is evidence-based, never restrictive, and built around outcomes you can actually sustain.
fields.philosophy_quote: Good nutrition isn't a punishment. It's a plan you can live with — one that respects your kitchen, your family, and your goals.
